notes.title: Snowy Devlog #5 - Snowman and his park
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to [b]fifth[/b] DevLog!

Chill out and prepare for some frosty updates in [i][b]Plow the Snow![/b][/i] 
We're bringing you a sneak peek into the latest developments, and we promise it's cooler than a snowman's carrot nose! (snowman joke intended, you will see ;) )

[h1]A Snowy Spectacle[/h1]

Our winter wonderland isn't just about the characters; it's also about the breathtaking level design that will leave you enchanted. Here's a glimpse of what to expect in this mesmerizing snowy setting:

[h3]From 2D concept to 3D world[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/c0986c9183f1729cc1e23281b031c520f175b9d6.gif[/img]

The level environment in [i]Plow the Snow![/i] is more than just a backdrop; it's an integral part of the immersive experience!
Here you can see a transition from a 2D concept to the fully 3D level!
We will actually use this map later for a ... well... map in menu! So you won't get lost :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/a48975609ba8e24692224976ef3d6599259a3cab.gif[/img]

Remember you can visit this level in our demo!
I like this shot from the bird perspective (or maybe a duck perspective?)

[h1]Snowman Takes Center Stage[/h1]

Now let's see a character in 3D - a SNOWMAN

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/23a67a8cb8b232c57ca23477f4da2854bec56c06.gif[/img]
[i]Shaped from the snow... or from the pixels?[/i]

CHARACTER BACKSTORY VOL 1:
Our friendly snowman started as a part of the winter landscape, but he's been upgraded to a full-fledged character! Yes, it's kinda weird don't you think? It's like: developer is making the game, doing some 3D modeling - let's say a barrel or something and suddenly says "[i]i will give this barrel a sword/gun and it will be a new character!!![/i]" :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/2a7e7404a2d7bb496c816afc80e2f501d222199e.gif[/img]
[i]He got promoted to a full character ![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/dd36bdf3eb7109120566a399bac11053ca6610d5.gif[/img]
[i]Don't eat yellow snow... or blue snow. Ever.[/i]

The snowman is no longer just a cold, silent observer. He's got a personality that'll melt your heart
But don't anger him! Or you will be slapjacked to death! Just look at his moves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/c299b1768548b9f1fcaff5df3ad54305a9e6fcaf.gif[/img]

Snowman didn't even have a 2D concept art :(
This is a fate because of his untypical "coming to life". 
[b]Are snowmans dreams about snowy sheeps?[/b]
He was just placed in 3D enviroment in the level and became a character later :D
He got some unique statistics and abilities but about that later, in the next devlog ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/0877790ad871574e29b7b46e75c0c61c9b05b9d5.png[/img]

We showed only [b]few[/b] of the characters from [i]Plow the Snow! [/i], more incoming soon ;) 
Stay sharp :D


Best regards,
Baked Games Team

notes.title: Snowy Devlog #4 - Crafting cool 3D props for the cozy Garage Level!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to [b]fourth ever[/b] DevLog about 

[i]Plow the Snow![/i] [/h1]

As the snowflakes fall and winter's icy grip tightens... just kiddinng!
There is HELL out there! at least 30° C!
I hope this devlog will chill you a bit ;)

[h1]Designing props for a the cozy command center - AKA The Garage[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/4a42d16ad02cd359fa425fdef4461af2e9ddc8f9.gif[/img]
[i]It's not blizzard in a garage, it just a low-res GIF because Steam won't allow better resolutions :([/i]

Remember the garage? This will be a level you will return to very often! And why?
Because it's a HUB level. You know, a base of operations. Btw, what's your favorite hub level in the game? Maybe a [i]Peach's Castle[/i]? Or [i]Firelink Shrine[/i]? Tell us in the comments ;)

[h1]Putting the PC in snowplowing command center![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/5c8c6043d62f1f46c0c9e819dd122944345b50f7.jpg[/img]

You wonder why this old PC?
Well, it looks old, but it's an important tool!
You can use it to navigate through your current tasks and messages!
You can also use it to buy new equipment, etc
We wanted to make it garage hub level because simple menus are often not very immersive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/cc888a9b00858baa151cfc07df343e2941fc0746.gif[/img]
[i]First sculpting and then colors etc. btw my PC is just plain black :([/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/0b832dc87f2c453722c7965058066cbf888578ed.png[/img]

We've created this virtual wizard to guide you through the icy streets with a mix of advice and maybe a few hidden extras. I call it a "dad joke generator", you'll see it one day :D (just to keep things cool!)

[h1]The desk-like cabinet - storing tools and dreams![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/70967450e23eea990d8cf48f856ae367111b4f8f.png[/img]

My grandfather had these in his garage, I swear (wait, I said "had"? It should be HE HAVE!!! Apparently his garage cabinet is older than he is and it's still being used! )

Enough of the side stories: check out this picture with these NODES.
It's a tool that allows you to set HOOK a specific configuration for a selected prop. It is useful and you can see this kind of solutions in other programs besides Blender3d (Unreal, Unity, 3dsMax and many more)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/b15577a87f59e14181085ab2240d37c621104501.png[/img]

[h1]Various tools - Snow's worst nightmare?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/0cf445eeceedee5e36014e061daf728d6fd26094.gif[/img]

Oh man, the tools! We have rolled up our sleeves and assembled a selection of tools that would make any snowflake tremble with fear. From wrenches to ropes to hammers (of pain ;) ), these tools are your secret weapons against the snowflake menace.

Or...

Or not. They are usually just for show! :D
If there's a garage, there always has to be a package of tools "for different situations"
And also a few "do not touch that" tools (as with my grandpa's garage)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/2bf83fa5dbbf5c496c829f625e528f4f6dd3bb76.jpg[/img]

[h1]Sneak peek at the secret character![/h1]

And now, the moment you've been waiting for – a sneak peek at one of our snowplow hero! This character is more than just a cap and scarf; they're the embodiment of winter's brave spirit!
More info soon™ ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/cf26b7cdfbbe901978afdb0240e7f6cbf9a236a6.png[/img]

Best regards,

notes.title: Snowy Devlog #3 - How to make a level !
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to [b]third ever[/b] DevLog about 
[i]Plow the Snow![/i] [/h1]

Hey there, snowplow heroes and heroines! 
In [i]Plow the Snow![/i], players take on the role of a snowplow operator tasked with clearing snow from various locations. 
Today, we'll dive into the development process of creating a snowy level set in a park.

[h1]
Welcome to the park![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/39f3d630579c3c31fa7034d069df604a6e364762.gif[/img]

Remember this level? You can visit it in our free demo !
Get ready to embark on an icy adventure as we spill the snowflakes on designing a [b]frosty park level[/b] that will make you want to do snow angels and sip hot cocoa! 

How to find snow-related research materials? 
Answer: go to the park in winter :D

[h2]Witnessing snowy challenges unfold[/h2]

Our park level is more than just a winter wonderland!
We sprinkled the landscape with all sorts of obstacles to keep you on your plow-driving toes! 
Watch out for benches, fountains, trees etc!

Our talented team of artists donned their imaginary snow boots and got to work designing enchanting winter-themed assets. We sculpted magnificent snow-laden trees that that you can see here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/adb966f1dbe683b041841c2d4b7647d13ae0a1e1.gif[/img]

[h2]Setting the winter scene[/h2]

Coping the same assets is fast and easy but the level must looks interesting and just looks good.
You can copy almost anything but the outcome is not always good :D Just look at those lanterns:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/47aec922340aa17dc1985f9725760121f7ab6b42.gif[/img]
[i]Do you think is it enought lanters?[/i]

Speaking of assets: You can always add as much as you want as long is not dropping a game performance. But you need a lot of [b]various [/b] assets. Not only benches and trees are in parks, fountains too! The graphic guy have a lot of work for every level a designer comes up :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/ef630f409672c395f9e14024739b51b8720adadc.gif[/img]
[i]Here a never seen before footage of what's under the fountain! (sadly no golden coins spotted)[/i]

[h2]Level design and challenges - snowy surprises await![/h2]

When it came to creating a winter wonderland, we couldn't forget about the trees!
Planting trees isn't just about sticking them in the ground and hoping for the best. We carefully selected specific locations within the park level to ensure the trees would not only enhance the visual appeal but also provide "strategic" benefits (will colide with player's vehicle :D)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/b30d2f77b38cf54ee8e4285bd89f11eb75bf601d.gif[/img]
[i]Exclusive look with and without the trees/plants! [/i]

Let's see how it looks like from the bird perspective!
From above, you'll witness the challenges scattered throughout the park, carefully designed to test your snowplowing skills and puzzle-solving prowess. 
Players must maneuver their plows around frozen obstacles and skillfully clear paths. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/7d876b11eac887644bb59b77425d3cc74133e178.gif[/img]
[i]Nice one, huh? Wanna visit it?[/i]

[h2]Final touches and fun with assets[/h2]

That's all for today, now i will sit on the bench and chill out a while.
Or maybe i'm looking at the my level FROM THE PERSPECTIVE of the bench? We will never know :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/fddb42c10681fd51f6e93cb75cfa04647e7989de.gif[/img]
[i]I'm a park bench?[/i]

Best regards,
Baked Games Team

notes.title: New art style in Plow the Snow!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome dear players! [/h1]

We are preparing something nice for you!

Our game [i]Plow the Snow![/i] is undergoing a graphical overhaul !

We collected a lot of feedback from our testers and [b]Players[/b] and we decided to change our game a bit ;)
Now it will feature more "stylised cartoony" graphic but a gameplay remain mostly the same - still you need to get rid of the snow in various places ! 
So this is still a "simulator" but more "friendly looking" :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/d5252db41df7ddc9f6d70c71db231d50f5890edc.gif[/img]

[h2]Environment - more stylised![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/87b9d5432e22303e5448fc934dbef96c7a7865b1.gif[/img]

Looks cheerful, right? ;)
Old one also have a gloomy climate, is a bit realistic and looks nice too i think! 
But this new one is gonna blow your mind ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/b3be9ba7fe36a72384b1241539bb9d15814f48a4.gif[/img]

Garage also has some overhaul! Remember you can use garage to repair your vehicle, select a level and other stuff between levels. 
I hope this new one will be a cozy place ! 
We need to add a comfy chair and some hot coffee pot for our characters!

[h2]Characters![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/1d4eda6261f344929eaa61f1e709fd05aba9b08d.gif[/img]

Old characters are just "normal" guy in winter outfit but these new ones... i like them a lot !
And hope you will too!
Well we were inspired by some "classic style" of characters. Let's say:
their names are [b]Maria[/b] and [b]Luigiano[/b] ;) so you know from where we has inspirations.
More characters will be shown later, keep an eye on new devlogs !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/75802b7d1a380809b31d3d60e76c2ad3fd1471b2.png[/img]

[h2]3D assets - reimagined ![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/dfa7cbb76ff78385b819852098893b03b9306f75.jpg[/img]

Old fountain and new fountain. More colorful, right ? 
But don't ever drink fountain's water! Not even a most pretty one! 
And never eat yellow snow, hopefully there won't be any in our game ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/b3489963b85dcf696edb3c0e4e20ed8aa2d9c3ab.jpg[/img]

An old asset for this special place in park was a human statue behind some fences but we changed it to [b]THE DUCK[/b]. Have you ever heard about [b]THE DUCK[/b] ? Oohh.. soon you will, everyone will hear about [b]THE DUCK[/b] !
Also we added some nice red bushes and leafes - strong plants remain in theirs colors even at winter ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/ec5bb1ebb2a3f9b8ed91ac5b7e9efb7b8be9967b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/69a67b59ada12fc5e7a0c2f572a25c52c9b25f1b.png[/img]

[h2]Concept arts[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/9cc0c8aed877f7cce3b5aa2f5e427fc325f4801f.png[/img]

Concept arts now require more hm.. let's call it "style" than real-world details.
Just take a look at this concept art of a sign.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/1a0b335811e4e9f8d6f13a54d5ec8eff49debe9d.png[/img]

And now in fully 3D in environment. Beautiful, right? ;)
[b]Snow Inn[/b] is a name of the park that you have to snowplow.
It's a first real level (except tutorial and garage) ! 
First levels are always most important for players and for developers to make them as best as they can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/ee3fece9b13859f934e76a9bf1b1e5147d9ae006.png[/img]

[h2]Summary[/h2]

So, what you think? Are you fond of this new art style? Or a more "realistic" one better suits you?
Tell us in comments what you think! Also you can join our Discord channel to futher talk about game and other offtopic stuff ;) 
And remember - [b]be ready to test this game by yourself really soon[/b] : D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/9b90f9129f79efa407314734450b09bd70458139.jpg[/img]

Best regards,
Baked Games Team

notes.title: Snowy Devlog #2 - Garage
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to [b]second ever[/b] DevLog about [i]Plow the Snow![/i] [/h1]

How are you? How is the weather? It's uterly hot in here where i write this article. It's hard to focus on snow in this conditions believe me ;)
In last devlog i promised the next one will be only about [b]snow[/b] in [i]Plow the Snow![/i] but something changed and this devlog will be about something other. Sorry snow-bros! 

[h2]Take care of your vehicle in Plow the Snow![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/2d9283346694753e98c1a4cf644e43ae8c0070f9.gif[/img]

Well the game will be about plowing some snow but except riding your machine you will have to take care of your gear! First let's take a canister. It's been here for quite some time... i wonder if petrol in in get stale :D

[h2]Change tires, change battery, change the world![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/7929478f3a93e0debe7126f32219d3610029893f.gif[/img]

Alright so now is time for some real maintenance: see an indicators in[b] left down corner[/b]? I'ts tells you when is something wrong with your machine. You know like the "check engine" symbol. 
Pay attention!! Tires and battery will often need changing every one job. So be prepared... [b]for high costs![/b] That's the price of good service!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/9b0b74c9abd51b88ecf55eac33c60ea6e46cee42.gif[/img]

Changing tires... better in warm garage then in the outside! Always be prepared for the job ;)

[h2]Let's pour some juice![/h2]

Okay, so our machine must drink some petrol to get things going!
Here i can show you a old way of doing it - we recently upgraded it but take a look:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/0c17eb43b98c0eb98fc38cec9a5b1e352de35475.gif[/img]

After hearing some feedback we decided to change a "minigame of filling the tank" to something else. Now you have to [b]press a button[/b] (possibly a LMB) to control how much you want to pour into the tank.
I hope it will be satysfying feeling in game ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/e794ec523ce69136c36bd8c2a516b10b903ce06c.gif[/img]

Ah, and sorry for a looks of petrol - let's assume it's a rocket fuel for now ;)

[h2]Garage - a great place for your machines![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/9bc310c58724940c86f2a4d838d49aa2d72ce483.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/8f2169d38bf5648086d08a8201a34c5d51241c11.gif[/img]

Okay, gasoline and tires are important but just take a look at the whole garage! Lot of place to store your vehicles and tools! You can walk in this garage but don't worry some aspects of gameplay will be automatic so if you really don't want to you can skip some activites.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/f7d8843db4d15777751fcfa2331c1c7eac51eefb.gif[/img]

Those garages kind of remind me of old times where i was helping my grandpa. You know the drill: bring this, bring that, keep a flashlight, hold a wrench etc. !
Helping someone is sure helping to understand some of the basics in engineering and how the machines are working! 


More info soon, next DevLog will be this time REALLY entairly about [b]SNOW[/b] and how to make some of it :D So stay tuned!

-----

Best regards,
Baked Games Team

notes.title: Snowy Devlog #1 - what is this game about?!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to [b]first ever[/b] DevLog about [i]Plow the Snow![/i] [/h1]


Ladies and gentlemen!
The snow is back! Like every other year our nemesis is back and it's still haunts our great city: [b]Snow Angeles[/b]! We need your help to get rid of it!

[h1]Welcome to the [i]Plow the Snow![/i][/h1]

You ask yourselfs: "what is this game about ?!" and here i'am to answer this:
[b]This game is about snow plowing.[/b]

Okay, end of devlog, back to work :D

Just kidding. But not truly: this game is about [b]having fun while snow plowing[/b] !

[h2]Basic info[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/95ac1f7cd15e57f1e20b672679b90db0dd0460cc.gif[/img]

Soo in our game you will drive various vehicles and trying to get rid of [b]snow[/b] in city. You can [b]customize your gear[/b] - i mean vehicle and your worker! You will have a lot of funny caps to choose from ;) [b]Cap is most important[/b], it gives you warmt fell on the head in the winter! ;)
You can also check your garage to fix engine, change tires and... [b]Hey! [/b]Careful with that petrol! Don't spill any droplet! It's very expensive now!


[h2]Various levels[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/287eacb549748ccc108482d2aa07e9f2149606aa.gif[/img]

I hope we can deliver a fun game where you can[b] relax[/b] while trying to achieve a 100% goal of plowing the snow from streets, parks, stadiums, parkings and a lot more! We have an ideas of a looot of levels so be prepared :) 
If you have any ideas where do you wanna see a lot of snow tell us in comments, we will consider each idea ;D
Well i can tell you in secret that one special level will be on [b]Alaska [/b]from our other game: [i]Alaska Gold Fever[/i]. Check it out ;)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1674200/Alaska_Gold_Fever/

[h2]Play with firends![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/4bbe0f69af04ab9749c9fc667a863088503dddd2.gif[/img]

You can even play with [b]your friends[/b]! (or foes...)
This game will feature online multiplayer - coop mode where you are helping your friend get a nice score and a [b]FOR GLORY[/b] mode where you compete with each other: who will first gonna rid of all the snow in the level! (the loser must buy a warm coffee for the winner)
Performance in each level will be rated depending on how good you was at snowplowing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320375/aa7b7a8f79aa5c4c84df93252933f69dff1ebddf.jpg[/img]
Who got the best vehicle? My bet on is on [MOD] cypher ;)


More info soon, next DevLog will be entairly about [b]SNOW[/b] and how hard to make some in videogame (seriously!)

-----

Best regards,
